checks.statement: Write button labels in sentence case, capitalizing the first word and proper nouns.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Buttons guidance.
Split the original combined record into independently assessable size, color style, and shape requirements; this check now records label casing only.

evidence.result: The specimen’s visible label is “Button”, in sentence case; generated cases do not provide product label authoring rules.

implementation.notes: The specimen’s visible label is “Button”, in sentence case; generated cases do not provide product label authoring rules.

checks.statement: For small buttons, use 16dp padding as the recommended value; 24dp padding is no longer recommended.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured M3 Expressive update guidance.

evidence.result: Small button leading/trailing padding comes from token variables; code does not resolve their current dp values to 16 versus 24.

implementation.notes: Small button leading/trailing padding comes from token variables; code does not resolve their current dp values to 16 versus 24.

checks.statement: Reserve filled buttons for the important final action, usually one per page; use lower-emphasis styles for supporting actions and avoid cluttering a screen with buttons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage guidance.

evidence.result: An isolated specimen contains one sample button and no page-level action hierarchy to evaluate.

implementation.notes: An isolated specimen contains one sample button and no page-level action hierarchy to evaluate.

checks.statement: Use toggle buttons for binary selections; use an outlined icon when unselected and filled when selected, increasing icon weight if no filled version exists.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Toggle buttons guidance.

evidence.result: Toggle cases expose aria-pressed and tokenized selected/unselected color styles; the catalog has selected/unselected rendering states.

implementation.notes: Toggle cases expose aria-pressed and tokenized selected/unselected color styles; the catalog has selected/unselected rendering states.

checks.statement: Keep button labels brief, ideally one to three words, in sentence case; do not wrap or truncate them.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Label text guidance.

evidence.result: The sample label is one word and button typography uses no-wrap/fit-content sizing.

implementation.notes: The sample label is one word and button typography uses no-wrap/fit-content sizing.

checks.statement: Place the icon before the label in left-to-right text and after the label in right-to-left text.
checks.condition: When a button has an icon.
checks.notes: Corrected to isolate directional placement; icon meaning, stacking, and count are represented by separate checks.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Icon (optional) guidance.
Separated direction-dependent icon placement from meaning, stacking, and icon-count guidance.

evidence.result: Icon SVG precedes the label in DOM, and inline flex follows text direction so the leading icon mirrors in RTL.

implementation.notes: Icon SVG precedes the label in DOM, and inline flex follows text direction so the leading icon mirrors in RTL.

checks.statement: Use a filled button sparingly for an important action that completes a flow.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Filled style guidance.

evidence.result: The single generic button specimen has no task flow or page actions that establish whether it is a final primary action.

implementation.notes: The single generic button specimen has no task flow or page actions that establish whether it is a final primary action.

checks.statement: Use text buttons for low-priority actions on simple backgrounds; do not underline them, and keep their label distinguishable from surrounding text.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Text style guidance.

evidence.result: The specimen does not render a text-style button in a real page context with surrounding copy to judge its priority or distinction.

implementation.notes: The specimen does not render a text-style button in a real page context with surrounding copy to judge its priority or distinction.

checks.statement: Align dialog text buttons to the trailing edge, which is right in LTR and left in RTL.
checks.condition: When text buttons appear in dialogs.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Text style guidance.

evidence.result: Dialog action layout is owned by the dialog specimen; the standalone button sample has no dialog container.

implementation.notes: Dialog action layout is owned by the dialog specimen; the standalone button sample has no dialog container.

checks.statement: Maintain at least 3:1 contrast against the background, measured on the container for elevated, filled, and tonal styles and on label text for outlined and text styles.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Color contrast guidance.

evidence.result: Button label/container colors are token-driven by style, but the 3:1 ratio against the correct backgrounds has not been computed for all styles.

implementation.notes: Button label/container colors are token-driven by style, but the 3:1 ratio against the correct backgrounds has not been computed for all styles.

checks.statement: On Android, keep labels concise enough to fit within two lines at 200% text size; if truncation remains, expose the full content through a single-tap alternative.
checks.condition: When supporting 200% text size on Android.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured 200% text size guidance.

evidence.result: Button content uses no wrapping and a min-content width, but the web renderer does not implement Android 200% font scaling or a single-tap reveal for clipped labels.

implementation.notes: Button content uses no wrapping and a min-content width, but the web renderer does not implement Android 200% font scaling or a single-tap reveal for clipped labels.

checks.statement: Make the accessibility label match the visible button label, adding context only when needed.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Labeling elements guidance.

evidence.result: The sample button’s accessible name is its visible text; it has no aria-label that overrides or diverges from “Button”.

implementation.notes: The sample button’s accessible name is its visible text; it has no aria-label that overrides or diverges from “Button”.

checks.statement: Button sizes are extra small, small, medium, large, and extra large.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Buttons instructions.

evidence.result: Styles bind xsmall, small, medium, large, and xlarge data-size values to button measurements and typography.

implementation.notes: Styles bind xsmall, small, medium, large, and xlarge data-size values to button measurements and typography.

checks.statement: Button color styles are elevated, filled, tonal, outlined, and text.
checks.condition: When selecting a button color style.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Buttons instructions.

evidence.result: Separate class mappings provide elevated and filled styles; corresponding tonal, outlined and text style rules are defined in the same stylesheet.

implementation.notes: Separate class mappings provide elevated and filled styles; corresponding tonal, outlined and text style rules are defined in the same stylesheet.

checks.statement: Buttons may use round or square shapes.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Buttons instructions.

evidence.result: The stylesheet selects round or square rest shapes and selected-state shape token variables.

implementation.notes: The stylesheet selects round or square rest shapes and selected-state shape token variables.

checks.statement: For small buttons, use 16dp padding as the recommended value; 24dp is no longer recommended.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured M3 Expressive update instructions.

evidence.result: Small leading/trailing paddings are variable-backed; the source rules do not resolve the recommendation’s specific 16dp value.

implementation.notes: Small leading/trailing paddings are variable-backed; the source rules do not resolve the recommendation’s specific 16dp value.

checks.statement: M3 default buttons are 40dp high with fully rounded corners; M2 buttons were 36dp high with slightly rounded corners.
checks.condition: When applying the documented M3 default dimensions.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Differences from M2 instructions.

evidence.result: Default/small buttons use tokenized height and round shape variables; values for 40dp and full rounding are not resolved in the authored rule.

implementation.notes: Default/small buttons use tokenized height and round shape variables; values for 40dp and full rounding are not resolved in the authored rule.

checks.statement: Use 20dp for standard leading and trailing icons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Differences from M2 instructions.

evidence.result: Small leading/trailing icon size is token-bound; this stylesheet does not establish the exact 20dp value.

implementation.notes: Small leading/trailing icon size is token-bound; this stylesheet does not establish the exact 20dp value.

checks.statement: Do not use the neutral text-button color style as the recommended M3 style.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Differences from M2 instructions.

evidence.result: Color style classes expose text and filled styles, but there is no implementation-level recommendation metadata for a neutral text color.

implementation.notes: Color style classes expose text and filled styles, but there is no implementation-level recommendation metadata for a neutral text color.

checks.statement: Use elevated, filled, tonal, outlined, or text styles for default buttons; toggle buttons use corresponding selected/unselected color mappings but do not use the text style.
checks.condition: When styling default or toggle buttons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Color instructions.

evidence.result: Toggle style rules select distinct selected/unselected token roles; default button styles support the listed styles, while toggle text style availability is not represented by a separate toggle mode.

implementation.notes: Toggle style rules select distinct selected/unselected token roles; default button styles support the listed styles, while toggle text style availability is not represented by a separate toggle mode.

checks.statement: When using color roles beyond the built-in mappings, maintain at least 3:1 contrast between the button container and its text.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Color instructions.

evidence.result: Custom color variables can be overridden, but no runtime contrast constraint/check ensures 3:1 for custom container and text roles.

implementation.notes: Custom color variables can be overridden, but no runtime contrast constraint/check ensures 3:1 for custom container and text roles.

checks.statement: Elevated buttons use elevation 1 by default and elevation 0 when disabled.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Elevated button states instructions.

evidence.result: Elevated rest/disabled elevations are token-bound; authored CSS selects them but does not resolve values 1 and 0.

implementation.notes: Elevated rest/disabled elevations are token-bound; authored CSS selects them but does not resolve values 1 and 0.

checks.statement: Outlined button containers are invisible at rest; state layers and opacity still communicate disabled, hover, focus, and pressed states.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Outlined button states instructions.

evidence.result: Outlined container is transparent at rest and focus/interaction state layers are driven by button state variables.

implementation.notes: Outlined container is transparent at rest and focus/interaction state layers are driven by button state variables.

checks.statement: Text button containers are invisible at rest and show state layers on interaction; text buttons do not have a toggle variant.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Text button style states instructions.

evidence.result: Shared button state pseudo-element provides interaction-only state layer, and no selected/toggle text-style selector is declared.

implementation.notes: Shared button state pseudo-element provides interaction-only state layer, and no selected/toggle text-style selector is declared.

checks.statement: Pressed buttons may become more square; round and square buttons share the same pressed shape, with the radius depending on size.
checks.condition: When a button enters the pressed state.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Pressed state instructions.

evidence.result: Pressed state uses a shared shape variable, with size-specific pressed corner tokens for every button size.

implementation.notes: Pressed state uses a shared shape variable, with size-specific pressed corner tokens for every button size.

checks.statement: A selected toggle button changes from round to square, or from square to round, relative to its unselected shape.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured When selected instructions.

evidence.result: aria-pressed selects separate round/square selected shape tokens relative to the chosen unselected shape.

implementation.notes: aria-pressed selects separate round/square selected shape tokens relative to the chosen unselected shape.

checks.statement: Keep extra-small and small icon-button targets at least 48×48dp.
checks.condition: For extra-small or small icon buttons.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Target areas instructions.

evidence.result: Icon button minimum width is icon size plus token leading/trailing insets; no code here enforces a 48×48dp target for XS/S sizes.

implementation.notes: Icon button minimum width is icon size plus token leading/trailing insets; no code here enforces a 48×48dp target for XS/S sizes.

checks.statement: Use buttons for discrete actions and avoid placing so many on a screen that they disrupt hierarchy; move lower-priority actions to overflow or use links, chips, or icon buttons.
checks.condition: When a screen has many possible actions.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage instructions.

evidence.result: A single component specimen does not represent a screen’s action density or hierarchy.

implementation.notes: A single component specimen does not represent a screen’s action density or hierarchy.

checks.statement: Let a button width fit its label; responsive stretching is allowed, but never make the container narrower than the label text.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage instructions.

evidence.result: Buttons use min-inline-size:max-content and no-wrap labels, preventing the container from becoming narrower than text.

implementation.notes: Buttons use min-inline-size:max-content and no-wrap labels, preventing the container from becoming narrower than text.

checks.statement: Within a related button group, emphasize the primary action more than secondary actions using size, color, or shape.
checks.condition: When a group contains primary and secondary actions.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Usage instructions.

evidence.result: The standalone button preview has no related action group to compare for primary emphasis.

implementation.notes: The standalone button preview has no related action group to compare for primary emphasis.

checks.statement: Use toggle buttons for binary choices such as Save or Favorite.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Toggle buttons instructions.

evidence.result: Toggle configuration emits aria-pressed and data-button-toggle for binary selection states.

implementation.notes: Toggle configuration emits aria-pressed and data-button-toggle for binary selection states.

checks.statement: Use an outlined icon while unselected and a filled icon while selected; if no filled version exists, increase the icon weight.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Toggle buttons instructions.

evidence.result: Selected and unselected icon/color tokens are separately selected by aria-pressed; symbol glyph variants are not automatically swapped by the generic button.

implementation.notes: Selected and unselected icon/color tokens are separately selected by aria-pressed; symbol glyph variants are not automatically swapped by the generic button.

checks.statement: Keep selected and unselected labels similar in character count to avoid disruptive layout changes.
checks.condition: When the toggle label changes with state.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Toggle buttons instructions.

evidence.result: The sample has a fixed label and no state-dependent label change.

implementation.notes: The sample has a fixed label and no state-dependent label change.

checks.statement: Use caution with outlined and text buttons next to visually similar text or chips; consider filled or tonal styling when needed for distinction.
checks.condition: When outlined or text buttons appear near similar elements.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Label text instructions.

evidence.result: The isolated button does not appear beside chips or similar text, so adjacent-element distinction is a product layout concern.

implementation.notes: The isolated button does not appear beside chips or similar text, so adjacent-element distinction is a product layout concern.

checks.statement: Let button container width follow the label and optional icon; avoid a fixed width narrower than the content.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container instructions.

evidence.result: Button is inline-flex with max-content minimum width and content-driven width rather than a fixed container width.

implementation.notes: Button is inline-flex with max-content minimum width and content-driven width rather than a fixed container width.

checks.statement: For text style buttons, show a container only for hover, focus, or pressed states.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Container instructions.

evidence.result: Base container is transparent and the pseudo state layer receives state color/opacity only for interaction states.

implementation.notes: Base container is transparent and the pseudo state layer receives state color/opacity only for interaction states.

checks.statement: Use the elevated style only when a button needs separation from a visually prominent background; avoid unnecessary shadows and prefer filled for high emphasis.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Elevated style instructions.

evidence.result: An isolated style specimen has no visually prominent host background or page hierarchy to determine whether elevation is necessary.

implementation.notes: An isolated style specimen has no visually prominent host background or page hierarchy to determine whether elevation is necessary.

checks.statement: Use filled style for an important final action and sparingly, ideally for one action per page; tertiary colors are also allowed in some cases.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Filled style instructions.

evidence.result: The sample is not associated with a workflow or page, so final-action priority and per-page filled-button count cannot be assessed.

implementation.notes: The sample is not associated with a workflow or page, so final-action priority and per-page filled-button count cannot be assessed.

checks.statement: Use tonal style for a lower-priority action that needs more emphasis than outlined, such as Next; it uses the secondary color mapping.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Tonal style instructions.

evidence.result: The isolated specimen has no primary action or supporting-action hierarchy.

implementation.notes: The isolated specimen has no primary action or supporting-action hierarchy.

checks.statement: Use outlined style for important medium-emphasis supporting actions, often paired with a filled primary action.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Outlined style instructions.

evidence.result: No task context exists to classify the sample as supporting action or pair it with a primary action.

implementation.notes: No task context exists to classify the sample as supporting action or pair it with a primary action.

checks.statement: Place outlined buttons on simple backgrounds; on images, use a contrasting fill or choose filled style.
checks.condition: When the background is visually prominent.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Outlined style instructions.

evidence.result: The generic specimen renders on the component showcase background; its local container/background treatment is not defined in this template.

implementation.notes: The generic specimen renders on the component showcase background; its local container/background treatment is not defined in this template.

checks.statement: Use text style for the lowest-priority actions on simple backgrounds, without underlining; use linked body text for hyperlinks.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Text style instructions.

evidence.result: The preview has no surrounding action hierarchy or hyperlink content.

implementation.notes: The preview has no surrounding action hierarchy or hyperlink content.

checks.statement: Keep text-button labels distinguishable from surrounding text and align dialog text buttons to the trailing edge (right in LTR, left in RTL).
checks.condition: For text buttons, including those in dialogs.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Text style instructions.

evidence.result: Text color is token-backed, but distinction from surrounding text requires resolved color contrast; dialog alignment is outside this standalone specimen.

implementation.notes: Text color is token-backed, but distinction from surrounding text requires resolved color contrast; dialog alignment is outside this standalone specimen.

checks.statement: Keep the icon and label grouped and centered as button width changes.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Resizing instructions.

evidence.result: The button uses inline-flex with align-items and justify-content center, keeping icon and label grouped as width changes.

implementation.notes: The button uses inline-flex with align-items and justify-content center, keeping icon and label grouped as width changes.

checks.statement: Constrain button width or position it beside other elements on large windows to avoid long, flat buttons with little content.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Resizing instructions.

evidence.result: The specimen is a single isolated button and has no large-window surrounding layout to adapt.

implementation.notes: The specimen is a single isolated button and has no large-window surrounding layout to adapt.

checks.statement: Keep items, including buttons, in the same order across small and large layouts for screen-reader and keyboard consistency.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Presentation instructions.

evidence.result: The button specimen has no adaptive parent layout or sibling action order.

implementation.notes: The button specimen has no adaptive parent layout or sibling action order.

checks.statement: Allow assistive technology users to navigate to and activate buttons that perform actions.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Use cases instructions.

evidence.result: Native button markup exposes an accessible name from visible text and standard activation semantics.

implementation.notes: Native button markup exposes an accessible name from visible text and standard activation semantics.

checks.statement: On the web, use the modified motion curve when rapid successive clicks or taps are expected to avoid overlapping animation resonance.
checks.condition: For web buttons with expected rapid activation.

evidence.result: Button has state transition timing and ripple animation lifecycle, but no separate rapid-activation motion curve is explicit in this stylesheet; shared motion runtime needs targeted browser exercise.

implementation.notes: Button has state transition timing and ripple animation lifecycle, but no separate rapid-activation motion curve is explicit in this stylesheet; shared motion runtime needs targeted browser exercise.

checks.statement: Use an icon that clearly communicates the button action.
checks.condition: When a button includes an icon.
checks.notes: The source requires a clearly meaningful icon.

sourceHistory.summary: The source requires a clearly meaningful icon.

evidence.result: The preview’s check icon is paired with the generic label “Button”; it does not identify a particular action, so icon meaning cannot be judged as an application control.

implementation.notes: The preview’s check icon is paired with the generic label “Button”; it does not identify a particular action, so icon meaning cannot be judged as an application control.

checks.statement: Do not place an icon vertically above and centered with the button label; keep icon and text together in a horizontal button arrangement.
checks.condition: When a button includes both an icon and a text label.
checks.notes: The captured example rejects an icon stacked vertically above the label.

evidence.result: Icon SVG and label span are horizontal inline-flex children, not vertically stacked.

checks.statement: Do not use two icons in the same button.

checks.notes: The captured guidance explicitly prohibits two icons in one button.

evidence.result: The sample contains one check icon and one visible label, with no second icon.

implementation.notes: The sample contains one check icon and one visible label, with no second icon.

checks.statement: Tab moves focus to a button; Space or Enter activates it.
checks.condition: For keyboard operation of a button.
checks.notes: Preserves both rows of the keyboard table as explicit button actions.
